caption: Williams v. Township of Cherry Hill
citation_line: Williams v. Township of Cherry Hill, No. 1:26-cv-00893 (D.N.J. July 27, 2026)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Williams dismissed a property owner's challenge to a municipal tax sale because the pleaded notice injury belonged to the mortgagee, not the owner, and neither Tyler nor the New Jersey Supreme Court's Roberto decision supplied third-party standing or the pleaded claim.
qualification_rationale: The opinion is a useful post-Tyler and post-Roberto application of Article III injury, third-party standing, and tax-sale notice doctrine. It qualifies at the doctrinal gate but lacks appellate or public-attention indicators.
appellate_posture_note: No appellate disposition was identified as of the cutoff.
